intended_rationale: Applicable ship has no loading-condition readiness case.

blockers.detail: For IMO-037-F01: Applicable ship has no loading-condition readiness case. No source-authoring default or canonical-unit repair passed the single-field, unchanged-applicability, schema and independent-oracle gates.

source_evidence.frozen_requirement_text: Ships of categories A and B, constructed on or after 1 January 2017, shall be able to withstand flooding resulting from hull penetration due to ice impact. The residual stability following ice damage shall be such that the factor s_i, as defined in SOLAS regulations II-1/7-2.2 and II-1/7-2.3, is equal to one for all loading conditions used to calculate the attained subdivision index in SOLAS regulation II-1/7. However, for cargo ships that comply with subdivision and damage stability regulations in another instrument developed by the Organization, as provided by SOLAS regulation II-1/4.1, the residual stability criteria of that instrument shall be met for each loading condition.

contract.comparisonModel: IF ship_category IN {'A','B'} AND construction_date >= '2017-01-01', THEN for every applicable loading condition either residual_stability_factor_s_i = 1 or, where the SOLAS II-1/4.1 alternative applies, alternative_instrument_residual_stability_status = compliant.

directCheckSubconstraints.description: Each external loading-condition result satisfies the factor or permitted alternative-instrument outcome.

contract.formulaExpression: For every loadingConditionCase, residualStabilityFactorSI = 1 unless alternativeInstrumentApplicable is true and alternativeInstrumentResidualStabilityStatus is compliant for that case.
